amortization.supports: Periodic rate, ordinary annuity present value and fixed loan payment.

annuities.title: OpenStax annuities
annuities.supports: PV/FV of ordinary and due annuities.

apr.title: CFPB Regulation Z Appendix J
apr.supports: Actuarial closed-end APR; cash-flow equation, regular and irregular periods. Regulatory APR is nominal annual unit-period rate.

tax2026.title: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32
tax2026.supports: 2026 ordinary tax, capital gains, deduction and other indexed thresholds; see separate JSON.

retirement2026.title: IRS 2026 retirement limits
retirement2026.supports: 401k/IRA annual and catch-up limits and income phaseouts.

fica2026.title: SSA 2026 fact sheet
fica2026.supports: 2026 OASDI wage base 184500 and payroll tax rates.

medicare.title: IRS Additional Medicare tax
medicare.supports: Additional 0.9%; final thresholds 250000 joint,125000 separate,200000 other; employer withholding threshold 200000 regardless of filing status.

ssa-pia.title: SSA primary insurance amount
ssa-pia.supports: AIME three bands and cohort-year bend points; not a current-salary estimate.

rmd.title: IRS RMD FAQs
rmd.supports: Prior Dec31 balance divided by appropriate divisor. Table II for sole-beneficiary spouse >10y younger; Table III otherwise, Table I for inherited accounts.

rmd-tables.title: IRS Publication 590-B
rmd-tables.supports: Current life-expectancy divisor tables and examples; historical pre-2022 tables differ.

cpi.title: BLS CPI inflation calculator
cpi.supports: Uses CPI-U all-items US city average; historical year comparisons need consistent annual/monthly data.

ca-mortgage.title: FCAC fixed mortgage agreement disclosure
ca-mortgage.supports: Example fixed rate compounded semiannually, not in advance; mathematical equivalent monthly conversion required.

ca-payments.title: FCAC choosing a mortgage
ca-payments.supports: Payment frequency and accelerated schedules; term is distinct from amortization.

sdlt.title: HMRC residential SDLT
sdlt.supports: England/Northern Ireland current marginal bands; first-buyer relief, additional home and nonresident surcharges differ.

va.title: VA funding fee
va.supports: Purchase first use 2.15%, later use 3.3% under5% down;5%-<10% down1.5%;>=10%down1.25%; exemptions. Updated2026-10-05.

fha.title: HUD Mortgage Insurance Premium appendix
fha.supports: General UFMIP1.75%; annual MIP must use applicable term/LTV/base-loan/date table. Do not apply0.55% universally.

bmi.title: CDC calculating BMI
bmi.supports: BMI=kg/m^2. Adults20+ and child/teen2-19 require different interpretation.

bmi-limits.title: CDC BMI FAQ
bmi-limits.supports: Screening measure, pediatric BMI-for-age percentiles and limitations.

harris.title: Roza/Shizgal 1984 original paper
harris.supports: Revised Harris-Benedict; abstract supports method/limitations, full coefficients corroborated via hospital institutional source.

macros.title: National Academies macronutrient DRI
macros.supports: Adult AMDR:carbohydrate45-65%,fat20-35%,protein10-35%; edition-specific nutritional references, not personalized prescriptions.

pregnancy.title: ACOG estimating due date
pregnancy.supports: LMP+280 days assumes28-day cycle; ART transfer date/embryo age; early ultrasound preferred for confirmation.

fertility.title: ACOG fertility awareness
fertility.supports: Cycle dates and fertile windows uncertain; calendar estimates do not identify exact conception or reliable contraception.

pregnancy-weight.title: CDC pregnancy weight gain
pregnancy-weight.supports: Singleton/twin ranges stratified by prepregnancy BMI; underweight twin recommendation has different evidence source.

met.title: 2024 Compendium of Physical Activities
met.supports: Versioned activity-specific MET table for19-59; verify licensing/attribution before copying entire dataset.

met-limits.title: Compendium corrected METs
met-limits.supports: Standard METs are population estimates, not precise personal energy costs.

tanaka.title: Tanaka et al 2001 original paper
tanaka.supports: Predicted max HR208-0.7*age for healthy adults; substantial individual variance.

gfr.title: NIDDK adult eGFR equations
gfr.supports: Race-free CKD-EPI2021 creatinine/combined and2012 cystatin C; coefficients,units,limitations. ReviewedMay2025.

bsa.title: Mosteller original paper
bsa.supports: 1987 BSA formula provenance; use corroboration for exact formula.

bsa-validation.title: BSA comparison original study
bsa-validation.supports: Mosteller sqrt(Wkg*Hcm/3600) and limitations in different body size groups.

army.title: Army ALARACT053/2024
army.supports: One-site tape test authorized; inspect current directive and worksheets before official compliance claims.

army2026.title: US Army 2026 body composition policy review
army2026.supports: One-site sex-specific method policy history; later official policy changes still require tracking.

bac.title: Alcohol calculations and uncertainty
bac.supports: Widmark distribution-factor model and uncertainty; cannot determine safe-to-drive status.

bac-factors.title: Hangover study methods appendix
bac-factors.supports: One explicit variant uses r0.68/0.55 and elimination0.15g/L/h, with0.5h absorption offset; factors differ by model.

eating-disorders.title: NIMH eating disorders
eating-disorders.supports: Eating disorders affect all body weights. BMI cannot establish or exclude a diagnosis.

ww-proprietary.title: WW SEC filing2025
ww-proprietary.supports: Company identifies Points as a proprietary nutritional algorithm.

ww-current.title: WW official Points explanation
ww-current.supports: 2026 current formula includes fiber/unsaturated fat/protein/saturated fat/added sugars; not equivalent to historical4-input SmartPoints.

army-male.title: Army DA5500 June2023
army-male.supports: Male one-site equation and age standards; page fetch403, search extract contains equation.

army-female.title: Army DA5501 June2023
army-female.supports: Female one-site equation; page fetch403, search extract contains equation.

army2025.title: Army ALARACT032/2025
army2025.supports: Male/female formulas and worked examples; nearest whole percent rounding.

ideal-weight.title: Peterson et al original ideal-weight comparison study
ideal-weight.supports: Table3 Robinson/Devine/Hamwi/Miller historical formulas; linear estimates not universal ideal weights.

nes.title: Nes et al HUNT fitness study

epley.title: Original resistance-testing study Epley method
epley.supports: 1RM=W*(1+0.0333*reps), not the0.333 typographical error in another publication.

brzycki.title: Repetition prediction study
brzycki.supports: Brzycki denominator1.0278-0.0278reps; that paper has obvious Epley and Lander transcription errors, so those variants are corroborated elsewhere.
